incidents.name: Email Delivery Delays to Microsoft Inboxes

incident_updates.body: We have identified the issue of delayed email delivery to Microsoft inboxes for the Twilio Email Send API. Due to a third-party provider dependency, delivery rates continue to improve, but some messages may still be deferred before reaching recipient inboxes. Delayed messages continue to be retried and preserved for delivery as service recovery progresses. This does not impact mail send. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

We have identified the issue of delayed email delivery to Microsoft inboxes for Email. Due to a third-party provider dependency, delivery rates continue to improve, though some messages may still be deferred before reaching recipient inboxes. Deferred messages continue to be retried and preserved for delivery as recovery progresses, and no action is required from customers at this time. We will provide another update in an hour or as soon as more information becomes available.

We have identified the issue of delayed email delivery to Microsoft inboxes for Email. Due to a third-party provider dependency, messages may continue to be deferred before reaching recipient inboxes, though mail send is not impacted and queued messages will continue to retry. We will provide another update by 7:00AM PST or as soon as more information becomes available.

Due to a third-party provider dependency, messages may continue to be deferred before reaching recipient inboxes, though no mail is being dropped at this time.
